video_caption: A young woman with long blonde hair, wearing a blue beanie and a grey hooded sweatshirt with “ROMINA” and light blue heart designs, stands in front of a white wall adorned with vertical strands of warm white fairy lights, speaking directly to the camera. At 0:08, the video cuts to a TikTok clip: the same young woman is seen sitting on a bed wrapped in a grey and white patterned blanket, with a blue and a teal pillow behind her. She dramatically falls back onto the bed, then reappears sitting up, looking surprised, while another version of herself lies prone on the bed, covered by the blanket. She makes hand gestures, first extending her left hand, then her right, then pulling them back towards her. The TikTok logo and the username “@rominagafur” are visible in the top left corner. The video then cuts back to the young woman speaking to the camera, where she smiles and makes various hand gestures, including pointing down, counting on her fingers, pointing to her sweatshirt, and finally holding a light pink smartphone in her left hand while pointing towards the camera with her right hand.

A young woman with long blonde hair and wearing a blue beanie and a grey hoodie with a light blue "ROMINA" logo stands in front of a white background decorated with string lights. She is holding a light pink smartphone in her left hand and gesturing with her right hand as she speaks to the camera. At 0:10, her phone's screen is overlaid on the right side of the video, displaying her iPhone's "Camera Roll" with various video thumbnails. The phone screen shows "2:52" (time) and "13,542 Photos, 2,047 Videos." She continues to talk, pointing a finger at the camera, and at 0:15, she taps her phone, which then shows a full-screen preview of a specific video. This video depicts the same young woman, now wearing a grey hoodie and black ripped jeans, kneeling on a bed with a white and grey patterned duvet, hugging herself and looking to the left. The background of the video inside the phone also features string lights, a white headboard, and colorful pillows. The phone's display also shows "East Rutherford" and "Today 2:06 PM" along with an "Edit" option. She smiles and makes a "peace" sign with her fingers while continuing to interact with the phone.

In this video segment, a young woman with long blonde hair, wearing a blue beanie and a grey hoodie, speaks directly to the camera. She holds a pink smartphone in her hands, looking at it and gesturing as she talks. Behind her, a white wall is adorned with numerous string lights, creating a warm, illuminated backdrop. On the right side of the screen, her phone displays a video playback. The video shows a bedroom with a bed covered in a patterned comforter, and several fluffy pillows (red, green, and blue) are visible. The wall behind the bed in the video is also decorated with string lights. Initially, a person with long blonde hair is seen lying face down on the bed, head near the edge. At the 0:02 mark, the video on the phone transitions, showing the same person quickly kneeling upright on the bed, looking towards the camera. The top of the phone screen displays "East Rutherford," "Today, 2:06 PM," and an "Edit" option.

A young woman with long blonde hair, wearing a blue beanie and a grey hooded sweatshirt, is holding a pink smartphone and speaking directly to the camera, initially gesturing with two fingers, then holding the phone with both hands. On the right side of the screen, a recording of an iPhone screen is displayed, showing a video of the same woman kneeling on a bed in a room decorated with fairy lights. The iPhone screen shows a video editing interface with a timeline at the bottom, indicating a 0:07-second clip, and "Cancel" and "Done" buttons. The woman is explaining how to cut a video into two, demonstrating by trimming the video on the iPhone screen, specifically selecting a portion of the video on the timeline.

A young woman with long blonde hair, wearing a blue beanie and a grey hooded sweatshirt with "ROMINA" written on it, sits in front of a white wall adorned with string lights. She holds a pink smartphone in her hands, looking at it intently and talking. On the right side of the screen, the content of her phone is displayed, transitioning from a "Camera Roll" gallery view showing "13,543 Photos, 2,056 Videos" to a single video editing interface. This video, labeled "East Rutherford Today 2:06 PM," shows a woman (likely the same person) on a bed with white and grey patterned bedding and two fluffy cushions (one teal, one pink). The woman on the phone is first seen lying face down, then dramatically sits up as her long hair flies upwards, before settling into a kneeling position. The foreground woman then adjusts the video's timeline, explaining she's making it a slow-motion video for a cooler effect, and the segment showing her hair rising replays in slow motion.

A young woman with long blonde hair, wearing a blue beanie and a grey hoodie, holds a pink smartphone and looks intently at its screen. On the right side of the video, an overlay of a phone screen mimics her actions. The overlaid screen first shows various app icons, then opens a folder containing several editing apps, and the woman taps on the "Video Star" app (a pink star on a blue background). The app opens, displaying its logo, and then shows a preview of a video with the filename "IMG_7926". She presses on the "plus" icon, and a menu appears offering "Select Song" or "Edit Video". She selects "Edit Video", which brings her to the "Camera Roll" where she taps on "Recently Added (131)". A "Loading..." pop-up appears briefly, followed by a grid display of various video thumbnails in the camera roll.

A young woman with long blonde hair and a blue beanie is holding a pink smartphone and speaking while looking at the screen. She is wearing a grey hoodie and is in front of a light-colored wall decorated with string lights. On the right side of the video, her phone screen is visible, displaying an app called "Clip Mixer" with various layout options for mixing video clips. From 0:03 to 0:08, the layout on her phone screen continuously changes: it starts with a large magenta section (labeled '1') at the top and two smaller sections (green '2' and cyan '3') at the bottom, then transitions to a vertical split with magenta '1' on the left and green '2' on the right. Next, it shows three vertical columns (magenta '1', green '2', cyan '3'), followed by a horizontal split (brown '1' and '2' on top, empty bottom), and finally a layout with four quadrants that are either empty or numbered '1', '2', '3', '4' in different colors (magenta, green, cyan). The top bar of the app consistently shows "3:03", "Cancel", "Clip Mixer", and "Mix Clips". She taps on the phone screen with her right index finger, indicating interaction with the app.

A young woman with long blonde hair, wearing a blue beanie and a grey hoodie, sits in front of a white wall adorned with string lights, holding a pink smartphone. On the right side of the screen, her phone's display shows a video editing interface with a vertical video playing, featuring a "ghost" effect where a semi-transparent version of herself appears to float above her physical body. The interface has "Cancel," "Clip Mixer," and "Mix Clips" buttons at the top, and a timeline with numbered clips (1, 2, 3, 4) and a "Multiple Exposure" option at the bottom. She explains how to increase the intensity of one of the video layers by tapping on it. A "Add Clip" pop-up appears, displaying four small video thumbnails of herself. She taps on one, which leads to a "Choose Clip 3" screen with two larger video thumbnails, labeled "Photo," "Text," and "Color" tabs. After selecting a clip, she returns to the "Add Clip" screen, then back to the main editing view, where she now has a new combination of clips showing the ghost effect. She presses "Mix Clips" at the top right, prompting a pop-up that asks, "Create Mix Clip?" with "Cancel" and "Yes" options. She confirms, and the screen then displays a "Processing..." bar, indicating the video is being rendered.

A young woman with long blonde hair, wearing a blue beanie and a grey hoodie, holds a pink smartphone in her left hand while gesturing with her right thumb and then both hands as she explains something. Her focused expression suggests she is demonstrating an app. On the right side of the screen, her phone's display shows a video editing application. The app's interface features a video player showing her (likely the same person) on a bed with colorful cushions, initially sitting up and then appearing to lie down. Below the video, there are controls labeled "Edit," "Select," and "New." At 0:07, she taps "New," which brings up a pop-up menu with various options like "Record Video," "Re-Effect Clip," "Import Video," "Transform Clip," "Import Photo," "Mix Clips," "Modify Clip," and "Multi-Layer Clip." The background behind her is a white wall adorned with illuminated string lights.

A blonde woman wearing a blue beanie and a grey hoodie is positioned in the foreground, holding a pink smartphone and speaking with an enthusiastic expression, frequently gesturing with her hands. Her smartphone's screen is displayed on the right, showing a video editing application. Initially, the app shows a blurred video of a person sitting on a bed with colorful pillows, accompanied by text options like "Cancel," "Create," and numbered layers (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8-10). As she interacts with the phone, a pop-up appears on the app screen, asking "Create Multi-Layer clip?" (Create Multi-Layer clip?) with "Cancel" and "Yes" options. She selects "Yes," prompting a "Processing..." message with a progress bar to briefly appear. Once processing is complete, the app displays the edited video along with new options at the bottom, including "Edit," "Select," "New," and "Add." The background features a white wall decorated with hanging string lights.

In this video segment, a young woman with long blonde hair, wearing a grey hooded sweatshirt with a purple design and a blue beanie, is holding a pink smartphone and demonstrating how to edit a video. She is looking at her phone, actively tapping the screen, and speaking while making slight hand gestures. On the right side of the screen, her phone display is visible. Initially, it shows her iPhone home screen with numerous app icons, including Snapchat, TikTok, Instagram, Messenger, Facebook, Gmail, YouTube, Spotify, WhatsApp, and Pinterest, with some showing notification badges (e.g., Messenger 17, Gmail 2,880). The background of her home screen is a glittery pink design. At 0:04, she opens the TikTok app, which first displays the TikTok logo, then transitions to her "For You" page. By 0:07, she taps the "+" icon to create a new video, revealing the camera interface with her own reflection. At 0:10, she navigates to her video library within TikTok, which shows a grid of various video thumbnails. She explains that she will be selecting two videos: one for the beginning and one for the ending, and proceeds to select two specific clips that appear to show her in a similar setting, kneeling on a bed.

A young woman with long blonde hair, wearing a blue beanie and a grey "ROMINA" branded hoodie, is speaking to the camera against a background of white string lights. She is holding a pink smartphone and demonstrates how to use the TikTok app. Initially, the phone screen on the right shows a video processing, then transitions to an "Add a Sound" interface with "Discover" and "My Favorites" tabs. She navigates to "My Favorites" and scrolls down, selecting a sound labeled "Hold On" by "Goalsounds." After the sound is applied, the phone screen displays the TikTok video playing. The scene then transitions to a full-screen view of the TikTok video itself. In this video, the same woman is seen kneeling on a bed with colorful pillows in the background. She shakes her head, then bends forward, letting her long hair fall over the bed. A visual effect creates a translucent "ghost" version of her sitting upright behind her physical body, which remains bent over. The TikTok logo and username "@rominagafur" are visible at the top left of the full-screen TikTok video.

The video opens with a young woman, distinguished by her long blonde hair, blue beanie, and grey hoodie emblazoned with "ROMINA" in light blue, giving a thumbs-up gesture against a backdrop of shimmering vertical fairy lights. She smiles and talks to the camera, gesturing with her hands. At 0:09, a text overlay appears on the lower left of the screen, displaying "Cindy Ngaihte" followed by "Done!!! Hope you see this! 😊 Love ya so much!!!" She then makes a blowing-a-kiss gesture, spreads her arms wide, forms a heart shape with her hands, and waves goodbye. The video transitions to a black screen, where the white text "Subscribe" is displayed on the left. On the right, three social media icons—TikTok, Instagram, and Snapchat—are vertically stacked, each accompanied by the handle "@RominaGafur".
